Download files from a taxonAlign data release

Source: R/data_release_helpers.R
download_data_release_files.Rd

Downloads (or finds already cached) any files from a data release – the ready datasets load_taxonomic_resources() reads, or the verbatim source exports stored alongside them (e.g. "nsl_fungi_taxon.parquet"), which taxonAlign.dataprep rebuilds references from. Most users never need this directly. data_release_versions() lists the releases; each release's manifest.csv lists its files.

Usage

download_data_release_files(
  files,
  version = NULL,
  refresh_cache = FALSE,
  cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("taxonAlign", "cache"),
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

files

Character vector of file names in the release.

version

Data release to load, a date ("YYYY-MM-DD"); see data_release_versions(). Defaults to the latest release, or, with no internet connection, the newest release already downloaded.

refresh_cache

Logical; if TRUE, re-downloads the files even if they're cached. Defaults to FALSE.

cache_dir

Directory downloaded release files are cached in. Defaults to tools::R_user_dir("taxonAlign", "cache").

quiet

Logical; suppress progress messages. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A named character vector of local file paths, one per file. Downloaded files are cached under <cache_dir>/data_release/<version>/; if the latest release can't be downloaded, the newest release already cached that has every file is used instead (never when version is given).

Examples

# \donttest{
# needs the internet: the release's manifest, into a temporary cache
if (curl::has_internet()) {
  download_data_release_files("manifest.csv", version = "2026-11-14", cache_dir = tempfile())
}
#> Downloading manifest.csv (data release 2026-11-14)...
#>                                                           manifest.csv 
#> "/tmp/RtmprT685d/file1c15744de30/data_release/2026-11-14/manifest.csv" 
# }
